description.value: Pemho Pub is Pemberton's main nightlife venue, hosting regular live music acts ranging from BC blues bands to folk-pop groups, along with specialty performance nights. The pub features arcade games and a full bar, with active event programming through at least mid-2026. The name 'Pemho' appears to be a contraction of its historical identity as the Pemberton Hotel, though the current website makes no mention of accommodation.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this as 'Pemberton Hotel' (tourism=hotel), but the website at pemho.com is entirely for 'Pemho Pub' — a nightlife venue with arcade games and live music events, with zero mention of hotel rooms or overnight accommodation anywhere on the site. The address (7423 Frontier Street, Pemberton BC) and phone number (604-894-6313) match between OSM and the website, confirming the same physical location, but the business function appears to have diverged from the OSM tag. A secondary email mismatch (OSM: pembhotel@gmail.com; website contact page: pembertonprospectpub@gmail.com) further indicates the hotel identity has been replaced by the pub identity.

The Pemberton Hotel may have converted to or been entirely replaced by the pub; accommodation may no longer be available at this location.
